scripts.start: NODE_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=development bash scripts/agentic/start-metro.sh && node scripts/agentic/start-interactive.mjs
scripts.android: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=android HEADLESS=0 REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=ios HEADLESS=0 REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios:device: APP_VARIANT=development IOS_SIMULATOR= PLATFORM=ios HEADLESS=0 REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios:launch: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=ios HEADLESS=0 SKIP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.android:launch: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=android HEADLESS=0 SKIP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.open:ios: open -a Xcode ios/SherpaVoiceDev.xcworkspace 2>/dev/null || open -a Xcode ios/SherpaVoice.xcworkspace
scripts.web: NODE_ENV=development APP_VARIANT=development bash scripts/agentic/start-metro.sh && node scripts/agentic/web-browser.mjs launch
scripts.deploy: yarn clean && NODE_ENV=production APP_VARIANT=production EXPO_WEB=true expo export -p web && rm -f dist/wasm/asr/encoder.onnx dist/wasm/language-id/tiny-decoder.onnx && yarn gh-pages -t -d dist --dest sherpa-voice --repo https://github.com/deeeed/audiolab.git
scripts.prepare:appstore: yarn setup:production && ./scripts/setup-simulators.sh && ./scripts/generate-screenshots.sh ios env=production && echo 'App Store preparation complete! Screenshots are ready in fastlane/detox/ios.'
scripts.prepare:appstore:force: yarn setup:production:force && ./scripts/setup-simulators.sh && ./scripts/generate-screenshots.sh ios force env=production && echo 'App Store preparation complete with forced rebuild!'
scripts.prepare:playstore: yarn setup:production && ./scripts/setup-simulators.sh && ./scripts/generate-screenshots.sh android env=production && echo 'Play Store preparation complete! Screenshots are ready in fastlane/detox/android.'
scripts.prepare:playstore:force: yarn setup:production:force && ./scripts/setup-simulators.sh && ./scripts/generate-screenshots.sh android force env=production && echo 'Play Store preparation complete with forced rebuild!'
scripts.prepare:stores: yarn setup:production && ./scripts/setup-simulators.sh && yarn screenshot:production && echo 'All store screenshots ready!'
scripts.build:ios:development: APP_VARIANT=development yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile development --local
scripts.build:ios:production: NODE_ENV=production APP_VARIANT=production yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:ios:production:local: NODE_ENV=production APP_VARIANT=production yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --local --no-wait
scripts.build:android:development: APP_VARIANT=development yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform android --profile development --local
scripts.build:android:production: NODE_ENV=production APP_VARIANT=production yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production
scripts.build:android:production:local: NODE_ENV=production APP_VARIANT=production yarn dlx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --local --no-wait
scripts.ota-update:production: APP_VARIANT=production yarn dlx eas-cli update --channel production
scripts.ota-update:development: APP_VARIANT=development yarn dlx eas-cli update --channel development
scripts.android:headless: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=android HEADLESS=1 REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios:headless: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=ios HEADLESS=1 REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.android:device: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=android ANDROID_DEVICE= EMULATOR_PORT= REBUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.android:device:launch: APP_VARIANT=development PLATFORM=android ANDROID_DEVICE= EMULATOR_PORT= SKIP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios:device:launch: APP_VARIANT=development IOS_SIMULATOR= PLATFORM=ios HEADLESS=0 SKIP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/agentic/preflight.sh
scripts.ios:credentials: APP_VARIANT=development APPLE_TEAM_ID=${APPLE_TEAM_ID:-G5DZE7G2V4} yarn dlx eas-cli credentials -p ios
